image_description: A wooden staircase interior featuring a prominent bannister system. The image shows a diagonal handrail supported by vertical balusters, following the incline of the stairs. There are newel posts at the corners and landings. The wood appears polished with a warm tone, set against yellow walls and white trim.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the handrail and the balusters. In AI images, these connections often look 'melted' or lack clear joinery details. Also, inspect the balusters against the bright window area; look for any faint ghosting or edge bleeding where the thin wood meets the high-contrast background. Verify that the newel post at the turn has a logical structural connection to both segments of the railing.
